verdict.rationale: Working Copy exposes automation and agent surfaces (Shortcuts automation, a WebDAV server, and the in-app Repository Agent), so least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack shows no mechanism for issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials or tokens to an agent. The SSH-key identities and the AWS IAM setup it documents are credentials for remote git hosts, not credentials the app issues to agents.
